title: Feeder landing event
description:
Published on <prefix>/trigger at QoS 0, on assertion and on clear only -- not on every triggered sample. One message is also published at startup, with value false, so a consumer that connects and finds nothing retained still knows the device is not mid-event.

BREAKING CHANGE from the predecessor: `value` is a JSON boolean. The predecessor emitted the integer 1 or 0 inside a JSON object, while its own documentation promised true/false and its only consumer string-compared the whole payload to 'true' -- three descriptions, no two of which agreed. See docs/message_changes.md.

ts.description: Epoch milliseconds, or 0 when the clock has not been set

value.description: true on assertion, false on clear

delta_g.description: abs(baseline - weight) at the moment of the transition. On a clear this is the settling delta, not the peak of the event: the peak belongs to raw_batch, and reporting it here would make two topics disagree about one landing.

weight_g.description: The sample that caused the transition

baseline_g.description: The unoccupied-feeder estimate the delta was taken against
